entities.name: Mélanie Henique
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mélanie Henique is a French competitive swimmer. She won a bronze medal in the 50 metre butterfly at the 2011 World Championships and a silver medal in the 50 metre butterfly at the 2022 World Aquatics Championships.
